purpose: Compare small-data planning trends with a common DrivoR planner
scope: Modified research baselines, not original-paper benchmark reproductions
dino_patch_alignment: Pad right6 and bottom10 after shared preprocessing; no further image resize
ssl_source: Fixed local OpenScene train recordings only

jepa.initialization: Public general-video V-JEPA2 ViT-L/16, including predictor and EMA teacher
jepa.stage1: Masked latent L1 with stop-gradient EMA targets; fresh optimizer
jepa.stage2: Native backbone fine-tuning plus common DrivoR planner

drivor.planning: Official query/value LoRA rank32, two-frame register fusion, common DrivoR planner

lpwm_sequential.initialization: Public LPWM Sketchy; no earlier preparation updates reused
lpwm_sequential.stage1: Native LPWM reconstruction, dynamics, KL and presence objectives
lpwm_sequential.stage2: Planning loss fine-tunes encoder, context, dynamics and command FiLM; decoder has no planning gradient

lpwm_joint.initialization: Same public LPWM and planner initialization as sequential condition
lpwm_joint.training: Planning plus0.1 times native SSL loss from first update

interpretation_limits: Upstream pretraining data and model sizes differ
Sequential versus joint differs in objective timing and learning-rate trajectory
One seed and a development subset cannot establish SOTA or isolated particle causality
Sixteen-particle adequacy is provisional and requires planning validation
